functions.name: IsMobilePlatform
functions.docs: Whether the shader platform corresponds to the ES3.1/Metal/Vulkan feature level.

functions.name: IsSimulatedPlatform
functions.docs: Returns true if the shader platform Platform is used to simulate a mobile feature level on a PC platform.

functions.name: IsFeatureLevelSupported
functions.signature: IsFeatureLevelSupported(Target, In Shader Platform, In Feature Level)
functions.docs: Returns true if the feature level is supported by the shader platform.

functions.name: RHISupportsMultiViewport
functions.docs:
Can this platform implement instanced stereo rendering by rendering to multiple viewports.
Note: run-time users should always check GRHISupportsArrayIndexFromAnyShader as well, since for some SPs (particularly PCD3D_SM5) minspec does not guarantee that feature.

functions.name: RHISupportsVolumeTextures
functions.docs: Whether the platform supports reading from volume textures (does not cover rendering to volume textures).

functions.name: RHIVolumeTextureRenderingSupportGuaranteed
functions.docs:
Return true if and only if the GPU support rendering to volume textures (2D Array, 3D) is guaranteed supported for a target platform.
if PipelineVolumeTextureLUTSupportGuaranteedAtRuntime is true then it is guaranteed that GSupportsVolumeTextureRendering is true at runtime.

functions.name: RHISupportsManualVertexFetch
functions.docs:
Whether Manual Vertex Fetch is supported for the specified shader platform.
Shader Platform must not use the mobile renderer, and for Metal, the shader language must be at least 2.

functions.name: RHISupportsAbsoluteVertexID
functions.docs: Returns true if SV_VertexID contains BaseVertexIndex passed to the draw call, false if shaders must manually construct an absolute VertexID.

functions.name: RHISupportsRayTracing
functions.docs:
Whether this platform can build acceleration structures and use full ray tracing pipelines or inline ray tracing (ray queries).
To use at runtime, also check GRHISupportsRayTracing and r.RayTracing CVar (see IsRayTracingEnabled() helper).
Check GRHISupportsRayTracingShaders before using full ray tracing pipeline state objects.
Check GRHISupportsInlineRayTracing before using inline ray tracing features in compute and other shaders.

functions.name: RHISupportsRayTracingShaders
functions.docs:
Whether this platform can compile ray tracing shaders (regardless of project settings).
To use at runtime, also check GRHISupportsRayTracing and r.RayTracing CVar (see IsRayTracingEnabled() helper).

functions.name: RHISupportsInlineRayTracing
functions.docs:
Whether this platform can compile shaders with inline ray tracing features.
To use at runtime, also check GRHISupportsRayTracing and r.RayTracing CVar (see IsRayTracingEnabled() helper).

functions.name: RHISupportsRayTracingCallableShaders
functions.docs:
Whether this platform can compile ray tracing callable shaders.
To use at runtime, also check GRHISupportsRayTracing and r.RayTracing CVar (see IsRayTracingEnabled() helper).

functions.name: RHISupportsMeshShadersTier0
functions.docs:
Can this platform compile mesh shaders with tier0 capability.
To use at runtime, also check GRHISupportsMeshShadersTier0.

functions.name: RHISupportsMeshShadersTier1
functions.docs:
Can this platform compile mesh shaders with tier1 capability.
To use at runtime, also check GRHISupportsMeshShadersTier1.

functions.name: RHISupportsWaveOperations
functions.docs:
Can this platform compile shaders that use shader model 6.0 wave intrinsics.
To use such shaders at runtime, also check GRHISupportsWaveOperations.

functions.name: RHISupportsShaderRootConstants
functions.docs: True if the given shader platform supports shader root constants

functions.name: RHISupportsShaderBundleDispatch
functions.docs: True if the given shader platform supports shader bundle dispatch

functions.name: RHISupportsRenderTargetWriteMask
functions.docs: True if the given shader platform supports a render target write mask

functions.name: RHISupportsConservativeRasterization
functions.docs: True if the given shader platform supports overestimated conservative rasterization

functions.name: RHIGetBindlessSupport
functions.docs: True if the given shader platform supports bindless resources/views.

functions.name: RHIGetStaticShaderBindingLayoutSupport
functions.docs: True if the given shader platform supports static shader resource tables.

functions.name: RHISupportsWaveSize64
functions.docs: True if the platform supports wave size of 64

functions.name: RHISupportsWorkGraphs
functions.docs: True if the platform supports Work Graphs
